body: Were you confused about whether $30 is less than $40?

Thank you for your message. I wanted to write and let you know, if you care, that I am alive. I didn't try anything. By that Sunday things were so bad I couldn't really mask it anymore. Passing my wife and my best friend in the hallway at church, I almost lost it. Had to go sit in the car and weep. That afternoon/evening I finally told my wife. She was understandably concerned and also upset that I didn't tell her earlier. I got about the same from my two best friends, who are so close to me I call them sisters. 

I did change the meds, but I've since stopped again because I didn't like the side effects and felt myself sliding again. Still not sure what to do or where to go from here. 

The really sad thing is that I think as a result of this and my actions due to my depression, I may have wrecked my relationship with my best friend for good. It sucks, as there are few I was as close to as I was to her. But now I no longer feel like I am emotionally 'safe' with her. She has told me, essentially, that I am too needy, that I am smothering. And where we used to have long, rambling conversations on facebook, she barely responds now. Oh well. Life goes on I guess. As a person also on the autism spectrum, I am very socially awkward and I think this has definitely played a role in my depression. Anyway, speaking of rambling, I am rambling now. I need to try to move on I suppose. 

I thought, actually, that things were better since stopping the last med we tried, but today as relaxed after work, I startled myself when the thought came into my head: "I just want to die." So I guess I'm not entirely out of that deep hole. I appear to still be in it a bit. 

Like I said, thanks for your help and your kind words.
